question: What rejuvenating transformation occurs through six months of sustained practice?
premises: The practice is performed for six months
The practice is sustained and repeated
Even an old person becomes youthful
inference: Six months of sustained practice transforms even an old person into a youthful state.
uncertainties: taruṇā āyate may be read as becoming youthful; form is slightly unusual
plain_english: Through six months of sustained practice, even an old person becomes youthful.
